_comment: Extraction-quality eval seed. Two kinds of case: 'document' cases feed a paste/file through KB fact extraction and check the facts CARRY the concrete values (not vague meta-statements); 'working_memory' cases feed a thread's dumps through working-memory synthesis and check it stays GROUNDED (no invented narrative filler). Run: python -m eval.extract_quality. Offline (fake) providers give a floor; plug in a real key to measure prompt changes — that's the point of the harness.

document_cases.name: decision_prose
document_cases.content: After comparing options we decided to use Stripe over Razorpay, mainly for its international SDK support. All payment errors must be logged to Sentry — non-negotiable. We verify the webhook signature using the STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET env var. Storage is SQLite (one file, local-first) rather than Postgres.
document_cases.note: Plain decision prose — the proper nouns and identifiers must survive.

working_memory_cases.name: sparse_website
working_memory_cases.intent: Build a marketing website for Crux, a tool that manages AI agents' context

steps.content: Make the site creative and non-generic, not a templated SaaS landing page
Crux features: automatic context fetching and hotkey-based context capture
Leaning toward a parchment / paper visual identity with a hexagon mark

working_memory_cases.note: Three real captures. The memory must reflect THOSE — not a hallucinated journey of exploring platforms and competitors that never happened.
